name: chart-frame
title: Chart Frame
description: The frame a published chart sits in: a title that states the finding, a line on what is measured, the chart, and a footer with where the numbers came from and a copy of them to take away. Every chart on a page gets the same frame, so a reader learns once…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/chart-frame

Installed to `components/ui/charts/chart-frame.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/charts/chart-frame';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/chart-frame

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
